name: macjamf-consultant
description: macOS voice-based JAMF troubleshooting consultant with Kibana queries (Electron + React)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --config renderer/vite.config.ts" "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json -w" "wait-on electron/dist/main.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone for real-time troubleshooting.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition is required for voice consultation.
